params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.entries
params.description: Job compensation information. At most one entry can be of type [CompensationInfo.CompensationType.BASE][google.cloud.talent.v4.CompensationInfo.CompensationType.BASE], which is referred as base compensation entry for the job.

params.name: data.annualized_base_compensation_range
params.description: Output only. Annualized base compensation range. Computed as base compensation entry's [CompensationEntry.amount][google.cloud.talent.v4.CompensationInfo.CompensationEntry.amount] times [CompensationEntry.expected_units_per_year][google.cloud.talent.v4.CompensationInfo.CompensationEntry.expected_units_per_year]. See [CompensationEntry][google.cloud.talent.v4.CompensationInfo.CompensationEntry] for explanation on compensation annualization.

params.name: data.annualized_total_compensation_range
params.description: Output only. Annualized total compensation range. Computed as all compensation entries' [CompensationEntry.amount][google.cloud.talent.v4.CompensationInfo.CompensationEntry.amount] times [CompensationEntry.expected_units_per_year][google.cloud.talent.v4.CompensationInfo.CompensationEntry.expected_units_per_year]. See [CompensationEntry][google.cloud.talent.v4.CompensationInfo.CompensationEntry] for explanation on compensation annualization.
